title: Low-Carb Portuguese Mousse
description: A rich, decadent dessert made with velvety chocolate and a touch of creamy milk, perfect for keto dieters.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.notes: Optional, omit for a creamier texture

instructions: In a double boiler or a heatproof bowl set over a pot of simmering water, melt the chocolate, stirring occasionally.
Once melted, remove from heat and let cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped cream into the cooled chocolate mixture until well combined.
If using milk, fold it into the mixture at this stage.
Add the granulated sweetener and salt, if using, and fold until smooth.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the mousse to set.
Serve chilled, garnished with fresh fruit or whipped cream, if desired.
